serverInfo.name: A-Pay Protocol MCP Server
serverInfo.description: Universal Micropayment & Autonomous Economic Settlement Engine for AI Agents on Base L2.

tools.name: apay_request
tools.description: Probe and automatically pay HTTP 402 crypto micropayments on Base Layer 2 with USDC or $APAY within pre-configured budget limits.

tools.name: apay_get_wallet_status
tools.description: Inspect the agent's active non-custodial wallet address, network, current spending guardrails, and total spent in USDC and $APAY.

tools.name: apay_set_budget
tools.description: Configure agent safety invariants and spending guardrails. Prevents runaway loops or overcharging.

max_per_call_usdc.description: Maximum USDC allowance for a single API call

max_per_call_apay.description: Maximum $APAY token allowance for a single API call

tools.name: apay_inspect_endpoint
tools.description: Inspect an endpoint to check if it requires an A-Pay micropayment, inspect the exact price quote, currency, and payout receiver without spending any funds.

url.description: The URL to probe for HTTP 402 payment requirements

tools.name: apay_get_balance
tools.description: Inspect the agent's live on-chain balances on Base Layer 2, including native ETH (for gas), USDC, and $APAY tokens.
